session_thanks: Anytime! Call me whenever you need me.

Hmm, {wells_spoken} isn't planned here. Log it anyway?

end_run: Finish up and close this run?

cards._note: What a card shows: title (big line) and detail (small line) per card kind, optional context (small line over the title) and header (the header's one line while the card waits); {question} / {detail} are the spoken question and the old detail. Slots: wells, group, reason, note, step, done, minutes, label. An empty slot drops its ' · ' part.

Snap the pages. Say take it.
